title: Staff and admin help pages
summary: Staff and admin help pages. The staff guide covers more of the app, and administrators get a new admin guide.
changes: The staff guide now explains shared pet records, verifying a caller, call logs and the description editor.
A new admin guide explains the Admin area: overview and plugin alerts, people and access, modules and versions, managed lists, recruitment forms, emails, maintenance and security settings.
The admin guide is in a new Support group at the end of the Admin menu.
Each help section has a fixed link, ready for the guided tour.
version_rationale: Minor: adds the admin guide and opens the Bookings and guided tour milestone.
validation: New feature test for staff guide sections, admin guide access and the Admin menu link.
Navigation, translation and route authorisation tests.
known_limitations: The guided tour that links to these sections arrives in a later release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The admin guide and the new staff guide sections are removed; no data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.51.2 Beta, issue #490 under epic #487, pull request #624.
